## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check` pass locally
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (enforced by commitlint)
- [ ] New/changed env vars are added to `src/config/env.ts`, `.env.example`, and the README
